entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes, I hope you can help me. I bought some shoes, and I think I need to return them. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number is... uh, hold on... VF88621. It's for the cycling shoes.

Thank you, Sarah. I've got your order right here. Okay, so before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

Oh, it's just... they don't feel right. I tried them on a few rides, and I keep getting terrible blisters. I also can't figure out the cleats, they seem so complicated. The whole thing is just overwhelming. I saw the policy on the website but I didn't really understand it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. I'm here to help. It sounds like a sizing and comfort issue, which is completely understandable. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the order was delivered 58 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the time limit was. I just feel so lost with this.

Not at all. Let me just pull up our policy... Okay, yes. According to our standard policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. Since you're at 58 days, you are well within the window.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can get a refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow. Thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
